rows.en: Sisk: "Ah! Your Highness! Y-y-y-you're bleeding!!"
Lodis: "Sisk... I'm all right..."
Sisk: "No! This won't do!
What if nasty germs get into the wound?!
Now, hold still!"
Lodis: "I'm in trouble now..."
Touya: "...Are you finished over there?"
Rest: "Yes. As we feared, President Horem
wouldn't listen to reason."
Touya: "Then he's dead?"
Rest: "Yes. That's when His Majesty was wounded."
Sisk: "There, all done!
Honestly, stop doing such dangerous things!"
Lodis: "That's easier said than done..."
Sisk: "Do you understand?!"
Lodis: "Y-yes... I'll try..."
Touya: "You two make a pretty good couple."
Lodis: "H-hey!"
Sisk: "Oh, Touya! ♥
Don't say that... Eek! How embarrassing!"
Lodis: "I'm sorry, but would you stop making
jokes like that in front of her?"
Touya: "I wasn't joking... Whatever.
Anyway, that means it's over, right?"
Lodis: "Yes. But it seems Cain
is heading for the royal capital."
Touya: "The capital? No wonder he never showed up..."
Celica: "Wait, Lodis!
Does that mean he's after Tix?!"
Lodis: "There's no doubt about it.
But there's nothing to worry about."
Touya: "But... Isn't Tix the only one at the palace...?"
Lodis: "It's all right. As long as he's there."
Touya: "He...? Don't tell me this has to do
with that 'request' you mentioned..."
Lodis: "More or less. Right now, at the palace..."
Tix: "No! I can't go with you anymore!"
Cain: "Is the suggestion not working?
No, that doesn't seem to be it...
Never mind. Your wishes don't matter.
There's no time left.
At this rate, Lodis will be a hero.
I need you to take a stand before that happens."
Tix: "Why do you hate my brother so much?!
Enough to use me like this!
I thought we were friends!"
Cain: "Hehehe... This is why pampered little princes...
Listen. I never once
thought of you as a friend. I was just telling you what you wanted to hear."
Tix: "No..."
Cain: "You really are a fool...
Rayfon is the only person I've ever acknowledged..."
Tix: "If it's Rayfon you're talking about..."
Cain: "I'm tired of talking to you...
Oh, yes. I've just had a wonderful idea..."
Tix: "C-Cain...?"
Cain: "Why didn't I realize it?
There was such a simple way...
If you died, he'd grieve..."
Tix: "Stop it... Stop it, Cain..."
Cain: "...Goodbye..."
Tyron: "Oh... A fine stroke.
But your step-in is weak."
Cain: "Y-you... You're alive...?"
Tix: "T-Tyron!"
Tyron: "It's been a long time, Your Highness.
I couldn't protect His Majesty, yet here I am, still alive."
Cain: "...Tch!"
Tix: "Ah! Cain!"
Tyron: "Throwing his sword and running...
It's conduct unworthy of a warrior,
but perhaps it was the right decision..."
Tyron: "What a shame... If he walked the proper path,
he could become a commander of real distinction..."
Tyron: "I came at the command of His Majesty King Lodis
and our new sovereign, Her Majesty Ciel."
Tix: "Huh? Her Majesty... Ciel?"
Tyron: "For certain reasons, Ciel now leads us all.
And for a time, I'll be serving
as your guard, Your Highness."
Growster: "...Thank you for your help.
I hereby pledge that Zigrim will withdraw completely from the Kingdom of Agarthia,
and that I will urge our parliament
to conclude a peace treaty."
Fores: "Your Excellency..."
Growster: "Even I don't believe a country can survive
on war alone. A commander must know when to withdraw."
Adjutant: "Just as I'd expect of you, Your Excellency. We'll be busy now."
Growster: "Indeed. I'm counting on your abilities."
Adjutant: "Yes, sir!"
Growster: "...Hey, boy.
If you ever can't put food on the table, come to me.
I might even make you a second lieutenant."
Touya: "Second lieutenant...? If you'd at least make me a captain,
I might consider it."
Growster: "Heh... Even second lieutenant
is too good for a greenhorn like you!"
Touya: "Heh."
Growster: "...Don't let your guard down against Ze=Ode."
Touya: "You don't have to tell me. And you
stop starting pointless wars!"
Growster: "Heh... Well then, everyone, good luck!"
Adjutant: "We'll take our leave too.
We'll see you at the treaty signing."
Fores: "Good luck! Come on, we're going."
Reamond: "Ah! Y-yes... Well, then..."
Sisk: "Oh... She's pulling him by the hand...
Don't they seem to be getting along nicely?"
Miyasco: "Yes. I'm glad."
Touya: "Oh, that's the one from before..."
Celica: "No way... Aidion?! What's going on!?
It was supposed to be completely dead...
Why is it moving?!"
Sisk: "...To think the pilot of that Armored Mech was Lord Rayfon,
who went missing three years ago..."
Miyasco: "I know. To think he was alive..."
Sisk: "Perhaps this will lift His Highness's spirits a little.
After Lord Rayfon disappeared,
His Highness was so terribly depressed..."
Derock: "Oh, it looks like they're here."
Celica: "Rayfon! It really is you!"
Rayfon: "Yes... It's been a while, Celica.
You seem even prettier than the last time I saw you.
You've cut your hair too... It suits you very well."
Celica: "Oh, Rayfon!"
Lodis: "Rayfon..."
Rayfon: "Hello. I'm back... Lodis."
Lodis: "...Y-yes..."
Rayfon: "Oh? Is that...?
It looks like you managed to escape safely."
Touya: "Yeah."
Ymir: "So the person you met in your dream was..."
Touya: "Yeah. It was him."
Rayfon: "I was able to get out shortly after that too.
I stopped by the palace, then came here.
I wish I could have arrived a little sooner."
Celica: "Tell me, that really is Aidion, isn't it?"
Rayfon: "Yes. In the distant past,
it flew to Earth... the world those people over there came from,
to be clear."
Ai: "Huh? So... it's an alien mech?"
Arthur: "But how did it come to be here in Agarthia?"
Rayfon: "To fight the enormous object you say you witnessed:
Vorlia. The excess energy from that battle was enough
to destroy Earth.
So Aidion and the other two, Sivarius and
Coolmarishin, used their power to transform the nature of that energy,
creating Agarthia.
In other words, Earth and Agarthia are two sides of the same coin.
They are one and yet different, while still
affecting one another."
Ymir: "Th-that can't be..."
Rayfon: "I know it's sudden and may be hard to believe,
but it's all true. Though all of this is knowledge
Grauzer, who's inside me, shared with me."
Touya: "Grauzer?"
Rayfon: "During the explosion three years ago,
I should have died. The one who saved me
was Grauzer, who had become a disembodied consciousness.
I didn't want to die. I wanted to live.
And when I came to, Grauzer and I had merged.
We took refuge in that space using Grauzer's power."
Celica: "Was this Grauzer the person
who arrived in Aidion?"
Rayfon: "Yes. I don't fully understand it myself,
but beyond Earth is something called the universe, and still farther away
there's another universe. Apparently they came from there.
Their home is called 'Lin Karma.'
It seems they originally shared a lineage with the people of the Solar System,
though that apparently isn't certain.
But one fact is that the humans of Lin Karma
and the Solar System look very much alike, so that theory
probably isn't wrong.
Grauzer was a scientist on Lin Karma who built Aidion,
Sivarius and Coolmarishin, the three Ultra-Offensive Shell Units
known as 'Shinkaio.'"
Touya: "...I have no idea what you're talking about..."
Ai: "So Agarthia is a world created in the aftermath of a battle
against this Vorlia, and it was aliens called
Lin Karma who did it.
And the mind of one of them, this Grauzer,
is living together with you inside your body.
And on top of that, he's the one who built
those three standing outside?"
Rayfon: "Precisely. The other two should
arrive soon, so I'll give you
a more detailed explanation then."
Touya: "Hey, there's more...?"
Clovis: "Come on, don't be like that.
We're getting closer to the truth.
Doesn't it excite you?"
Touya: "..."
Clovis: "Hey, are you listening?"
Touya: "Hey, do Lodis and Rayfon not get along?
There's been a pretty tense atmosphere between them..."
Ymir: "That shouldn't be the case.
They were very close...
But now that you mention it,
I hadn't seen them together even before
Rayfon was caught in the explosion..."
Celica: "Rayfon... Are you still... about Lodis...?"
Fain: "...Hm? Whoa!"
Clovis: "Oh-ho... So these are the two he mentioned..."
Derock: "Mmm... Quite a sight..."
Touya: "...What are you guys doing...?
Hm? Oh! It's that old man!"
????: "Oh, you've been well, have you? ...Hm?
What is it, Rishuna? What's that? Introductions?
Oh, how careless of me.
A-ahem. Yes, I'm Valga Solma.
Feel free to call me 'Valga-cchi.'"
Touya: "R-right..."
Valga: "What's this? You're no fun.
Never mind. And this lively young gal here is...
Come on, what are you doing? Don't be shy. Say hello."
????: "U-um... My name is Rishuna Milsh..."
Touya: "Are you two aliens from this Lin Karma place too?"
Valga: "Indeed. But unlike Rishuna here
and Grauzer, I'm in my own body."
Touya: "Your own body?"
Rishuna: "This body originally belongs to a girl named Mana Elua.
I'm 'borrowing' it.
Though Grauzer's situation seems to be different..."
Rayfon: "Grauzer trusts me."
Touya: "Huh... Hm? Hang on...
You came here and Agarthia was created, right?
Then, old man, just how old are you?"
Valga: "It's rude to ask an old man his age.
My age and all three measurements are a secret."
Touya: "What a goofy old man. Anyway,
you came to beat those Ze=Ode guys too, right?"
Rishuna: "Vorlia, not Ze=Ode."
Celica: "Right, just what is this Vorlia?
Both Debish and Rayfon mentioned it..."
Rayfon: "Rishuna, would you?"
Rishuna: "Yes, of course.
Rishuna: "...To put it simply, Vorlia is
a 'vessel.'
But what goes inside is the 'consciousness' of intelligent life.
Vorlia was created to collect
that 'consciousness.'
For that reason, Vorlia has no will of its own.
It merely carries out the command it was given:
'Collect consciousness.'"
Celica: "W-wait. Isn't that the same as the 'plan'
Dr. Debish talked about?"
Rishuna: "Yes. The Ze=Ode Spirit Mech he pilots
is merely an extension of Vorlia..."
Celica: "I see... But who made something like that
and sent it here, and for what purpose?"
Rishuna: "We know that people from another planet sent it,
but as for their purpose...
It appears that this isn't the only Vorlia.
They've been sent to many different universes."
Touya: "There are more of those things?!"
Rishuna: "There have been no reports of multiple Vorlias
in the same galaxy.
But we have confirmed that more than one exists.
Our own Lin Karma was effectively
destroyed by Vorlia. Only the three of us escaped."
Touya: "This is getting pretty crazy,
but does that mean if this Vorlia comes back, everyone
in this world will disappear?"
Valga: "Yes. All Vorlia wants
is the information held by intelligent life in other universes.
It seems to have no interest in resources or technology.
Only the living things vanish from a world it visits.
Vorlia is summoned when the six Ze=Ode Spirit Mechs,
including that Rayblade you pilot,
come together. Now that the path has opened again,
the only way to stop it is to destroy Vorlia itself."
Touya: "...And that's where you come in?
Why didn't you do anything before...?"
Rayfon: "We... Or rather, the disembodied consciousnesses inside
me and Rishuna, along with Valga, somehow sealed Vorlia.
Then, with their power exhausted, they went to sleep."
Rishuna: "With Vorlia's signal set as the trigger to wake us."
Valga: "I woke when Goderius revived,
but Grauzer was caught between dimensions
and couldn't do anything.
So Rishuna and I had no choice but to attack Vorlia
ourselves. Just pushing it back
was all we could manage! Dahahahaha!"
Yamato: "That old man's laughing..."
Touya: "So what now? Will it come back again?"
Rishuna: "Probably. But Vorlia has already
appeared here once. Perhaps it can now be summoned
without all six coming together..."
Celica: "What?! Then there's nothing
we can do about it!"
Rayfon: "Calm down.
Several days have passed with no sign of that happening.
Doesn't that suggest some other factor is involved?"
Touya: "...You talk like it's someone else's problem."
Rayfon: "I'm sorry if I offended you.
But ultimately, our objective is the same as yours.
We have no intention of opposing you."
Rishuna: "..."
Valga: "In any case, for now we have no choice
but to work together."
Ymir: "We'd appreciate that as well."
Rayfon: "I have something to take care of, so I'll excuse myself."
Celica: "Huh? But we've only just seen you again..."
Rayfon: "Celica, it's hard for me to leave you too.
But this concerns all of Agarthia
and Earth. I'd be glad if you could understand."
Celica: "Okay..."
Rayfon: "Hehehe... That's a good girl.
Well then, everyone, farewell..."
Valga: "Now then, I think we'll impose on your hospitality for a while.
Eh, Rishuna?"
Rishuna: "...Huh? O-oh, yes. Thank you for having us."
Rosalie: "Gen..."
Gen: "It can't be true... I'd finally found him...
Dad..."
Rosalie: "Gen, was it really Dad
in that Armored Mech? Couldn't you be mistaken...?"
Gen: "No! Just because I was little
doesn't mean I wouldn't recognize my own father!
And he knew about the scar on my back."
Rosalie: "..."
Gen: "Only our family should know about that scar.
You, Mom and Dad..."
Rosalie: "B-but he abandoned us!
What good does it do for someone like that to show up now...?"
Gen: "Do you really mean that, Sis?!
Dad might have had
his own reasons!
And he protected me..."
Mechanic B: "Kid! We just got word!
That pilot's alive!"
Gen: "What?!"
Mechanic B: "They found him during the recovery work.
He's being treated in the infirmary..."
Mechanic B: "...right now... Huh?"
Rosalie: "..."
Mechanic B: "Hm? You're not going?
Anyway, he's in the infirmary. See you."
Rosalie: "...Now...? It's too late... It's too late now..."
Gen: "Dad! Dad!"
Gabon: "Shh. He's asleep.
I know how you feel, but he was badly hurt.
Leave him in peace for now."
Gen: "Huh? Then Dad's..."
Gabon: "Hey, Gen. Who do you think I am? Hm?"
Gen: "All riiight! Gabon, old buddy!
You're the best!"
Gabon: "Hahaha! Well, that's how it is,
so be patient a little longer."
Gen: "Th-then... Can I just look at his face?
I promise I won't make a sound..."
Gabon: "...I suppose I can't say no. Just for a moment, all right?
And don't tell Miyasco.
Maki's sleeping too, and Miyasco's strict about things like this."
Gen: "Okay! It's a promise, man to man!"
Gabon: "Good. This way, then..."

Murk: "How's it looking?"
Bernst: "There's no problem.
Still, I'm impressed you have all this equipment."
Murk: "It's my pride and joy, my private lab.
But don't tell the Agarthian parliament."
Bernst: "Yes, I understand.
If I hadn't met you, this child would have
died like he did..."
Murk: "He? You mean you have another...?"
Bernst: "Well, he was a clone.
I made a few genetic alterations, which made him unstable...
I did warn him."
Murk: "Could that be the man who
was pulling the strings behind the coup in the royal capital?
I believe his name was... Cain?"
Bernst: "Oh, you're well informed.
You must have quite a capable informant."
Assistant: "Dooctor... Aah!"
Assistant: "Oww..."
Murk: "Honestly, how many times have I told you not to run?
There's a slight change in level there."
Bernst: "...It looks perfectly flat to me..."
Murk: "Oh, pay no mind.
This one's a little unusual."
Bernst: "Ah. A little... you say..."
Murk: "Anyway, what's got you in such a hurry?"
Assistant: "Umm, well, about
Mr. Bernst, the person you helped, Doctor...
It looks like he's with Ze=Ode."
Bernst: "..."
Murk: "By Bernst, do you mean that gentleman over there?"
Assistant: "Huh? ...Agh!"
Murk: "You're as careless as ever. Never mind.
...So, is it true?"
Bernst: "...What would you do if it were?"
Murk: "Hmm... It's no concern of mine.
I can collect valuable data this way,
and above all, I've taken a liking to you.
Stay here as long as you like."
Bernst: "..."
Murk: "My own research matters more. Does that reassure you?"
Bernst: "...I see.
For better or worse, you truly are an 'Alchemist.'
Then I'll accept your hospitality a little longer."
Murk: "Indeed. Oh, yes. What happened to your Armored Mech?
If you like, I can combine it with my Baluamy technology
and modify it to be even more powerful!"
Bernst: "...I'll pass."

review_batches.context: Entire member read. Post-Horem treatment/teasing and report, Cain/Tix confrontation and Tyron rescue; alternate later paths checked.
review_batches.decisions: Keep Sisk's Your Highness habit distinct from king title, nonexplicit adult teasing, reported Horem death, Cain's coercion/murder threat and Tyron's survival/regret. No unidentified shooter or insurance mechanism invented.

row_decisions.scenario.s_021.o00087.l00: Sisk says Prince/Your Highness despite Lodis now being king; preserve her source address instead of silently promoting it to Majesty.
row_decisions.scenario.s_021.o000d0.l01: Ordinary fictional wound concern, not adding medical advice or treatment technique.
row_decisions.scenario.s_021.o0019b.l00: Rest explicitly confirms Horem dead in this branch and dates Lodis wound; does not name shooter.
row_decisions.scenario.s_021.o00275.l00: Heart retained as player-visible symbol; native font support remains pending.
row_decisions.scenario.s_021.o002ac.l00: Lodis asks Touya to stop teasing in front of Sisk, not Sisk to stop treating wound.
row_decisions.scenario.s_021.o00314.l00: Cain destination remains report, not completed attack.
row_decisions.scenario.s_021.o003ed.l00: He is Lodis's trusted protector, male Tyron identified by following scene; don't name him before reveal.
row_decisions.scenario.s_021.o00410.l01: Request is deliberately incomplete inference, no invented terms of contract.
row_decisions.scenario.s_021.o004f6.l00: Suggestion is coercive mental suggestion in story, not friendly advice; effect questioned then reassessed.
